roadmap.title: Chapters 1-10: start a Classic run
roadmap.description: Start a New Game on Classic and never change the difficulty. Win the Chapter 5 race, then decide where to drive Paulie. Take the story collectibles listed under each chapter as you go. Free Ride opens after Chapter 1.

roadmap.title: Chapters 11-20: finish the Classic run
roadmap.description: Keep Classic selected to the end. Escape the prison in Chapter 17 for the five-star chase. Finishing Chapter 20 unlocks both difficulty achievements.

roadmap.title: Free Ride and Chapter Select cleanup
roadmap.description: Do the police, car, and bike achievements in Free Ride. Pick up the postcards in Bertone's Autoservice and take the hidden cars. Use the checklists to finish every magazine, comic, card, and fox. Use Chapter Select to retake anything missed in a chapter.

achievements.description: Completed the game on Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the story on Easy, Medium, Hard, or Classic difficulty.

guide.context: A Classic completion also unlocks this, so a Classic run needs no second playthrough.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Chapter 20: The Death of Art} in a story run on any difficulty.

achievements.summary: Finish first in the three-lap, 16-driver race in Chapter 5, Fair Play.

guide.context: The race follows your difficulty setting, so it is far harder on Classic. Do not lower the difficulty to ease it if you want Made Man.

steps.text: Brake early before the big corners, especially the first one. The car spins easily if you steer too hard.
Tap the Ram button (F on PC) in corners to steady the car and gain speed. Tap it on straights for a boost, without steering.
If you spin out or fall far behind, pause and restart from the checkpoint at once.
On the last straight, check behind you and cut in front of rivals so they cannot pass.

achievements.description: Paid a fine to the Lost Heaven Police Department
achievements.summary: Get fined by the Lost Heaven police for a one-star offence.

steps.text: In front of a police officer, commit a minor offence: run a red light, speed, bump a police car slowly, fire your gun in public, or start a fistfight with a civilian.
Leave your car and stay still. Press nothing while the officer walks up. The fine is paid automatically.
If the police ignore you, switch the Police Response option to Realistic in the gameplay settings.

achievements.description: Resisted arrest by the Lost Heaven Police Department
achievements.summary: Resist arrest during a two-star police chase.

guide.context: Stealing or lockpicking a car in sight of people raises two stars, so this can share a trip with Car Enthusiast.

steps.text: Reach two stars: steal or lockpick a car where people can see you, or run someone over.
Stop and let the police come to you. Step out when they tell you to.
When the arrest starts, a prompt shows briefly. Use the dodge key (Left Alt on PC) while it is on screen.

achievements.description: Lost the cops after accruing a five star police chase
achievements.summary: Lose the police after reaching a five-star wanted level.

guide.context: In Chapter 17 you get five stars automatically after you escape the prison. If you end up with only four, keep shooting police until you reach five.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 17: Election Campaign}, escape the prison to start the five-star chase.
Break the police's line of sight. Jump a barricade with a white minimap icon to wreck the cop cars, or steal a car, drive a short way, and continue on foot.
Hide behind crates at the docks, or with the protesters near where you entered the prison, until the stars clear.
You can also do this in Free Ride: shoot police until you have five stars, then get in a vehicle and lose them.

achievements.description: Lockpicked 5 cars on the streets of Lost Heaven and environs
achievements.summary: Lockpick five parked cars around Lost Heaven.

guide.context: Lockpicking unlocks in Chapter 4, so do this after that chapter.

steps.text: In Free Ride, walk up to cars parked at the roadside. A parking lot near @loc{Salieri's Bar} works well.
Lockpick five cars (V on PC).
If someone sees you, they call the police. Move away out of sight before they arrive.

achievements.description: Reached 50mph while driving the Bolt Ace
achievements.summary: Reach 50 mph in the Bolt Ace.

guide.context: 50 mph is the Bolt Ace's top speed, so you need a long straight or a downhill run.

steps.text: In Free Ride, open the garage at @loc{Salieri's Bar} and take out the @item{Bolt Ace}.
Drive onto the @loc{Giuliani Bridge}, the big red bridge between @loc{Central Island} and @loc{Downtown}. Tap the Ram button repeatedly without steering.
The slope on the far side pushes you past 50 mph. The straight @loc{West River Tunnel} also works.

achievements.summary: Hold a motorcycle wheelie for 3 seconds.

steps.text: In Free Ride, find a motorcycle (the Haverley Tomahawk). Check the garage at @loc{Salieri's Bar}, or steal one from the street.
On a flat road, hold the accelerator and the handbrake together to rev the engine.
Release the handbrake while still holding the accelerator, then lean back (Comma on PC) for 3 seconds.

achievements.summary: Add 15 different vehicles to the Free Ride garage.

guide.context: About 15 vehicles come from finishing the story. A vehicle is added once you sit in it for a few seconds, and each type counts once.

steps.text: Finish the story. Most of the first 15 vehicles come from missions.
In Free Ride, open the garage at @loc{Salieri's Bar} to check the count. Steal and enter any new vehicle you see to add more.

achievements.summary: Add 30 different vehicles to the Free Ride garage.

guide.context: The garage holds 36 vehicles: 26 come from the story and Free Ride streets, 5 from the hidden cars, and the rest from phone booth jobs. The Carcyclopedia on the title screen lists 49 and does not count.

steps.text: Collect the five hidden cars (see Car Thief Number One).

Sit in every new vehicle type you see. Each district has its own cars: high-end cars in @loc{Beech Hill}, @loc{Oakwood}, and @loc{Downtown}; middle-class cars around @loc{Central Island}, @loc{Little Italy}, and @loc{Chinatown}; trucks in @loc{Works Quarter} and the countryside.

If you are still short, do the phone booth jobs. Pick up the note lying on the pool table in @loc{Salieri's Bar}, then answer the ringing booth in west @loc{Little Italy}. Later booths open after you read the notes that appear in the bar. The cars you win include the Crazy Horse, Smith Moray, Waybar Concept, Brubaker Forte, Carozella C-Series, and Mutagen.

achievements.summary: Pick up one pulp magazine of any of the four types.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 3: Molotov Party}, take the Dime Detective magazine from the table in the room where you collect the Molotovs. In Free Ride, @item{Super Science Stories #1} lies in the garage of @loc{Salieri's Bar}.

achievements.summary: Find all 80 pulp magazines: 20 each of Dime Detective, Black Mask, Super Science Stories, and Terror Tales.

guide.context: 32 magazines are in story chapters and 48 are in Free Ride. Free Ride opens after Chapter 1. Anything you miss in a chapter can be taken later through Chapter Select. Pickups save at once and carry over to new games. The collection menu shows what you have, and can sort by in-game number to find gaps. Nearby magazines show as colored icons on the minimap.

achievements.summary: Reach 100% in the collection menu with all pulp magazines, comics, cigarette cards, postcards, and hidden cars.

guide.context: Mystery Foxes do not count. The collection menu shows your progress.

steps.text: Complete the Lending Library, Picture Book Connoisseur, Full Set, and Car Thief Number One checklists.
Make sure you have all five postcards from the noticeboard in Bertone's Autoservice in @loc{Downtown}.
Open the collection menu and confirm that progress reads 100%.

achievements.description: Took Paulie to a Place of Disrepute
achievements.summary: After winning the Chapter 5 race, drive Paulie to the Blue Tropics gentlemen's club on Central Island instead of taking him home.

guide.context: If you drive Paulie home first, replay Chapter 5 from Chapter Select to earn it.

steps.text: Win the race in @loc{Chapter 5: Fair Play}.
Drive @npc{Paulie} to @loc{Blue Tropics}, on the south-west side of @loc{Central Island}. Do not follow the yellow marker to his home.

achievements.description: Completed the game on Classic difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the whole story on Classic difficulty without ever changing the difficulty.

guide.context: On Classic you die in 3-4 hits, enemies take double damage, med kits heal less, and ammo left in a magazine is lost when you reload. Police react to minor traffic offences and chase longer. The Chapter 5 race is by far the hardest part. Only a run started with New Game counts, so Chapter Select cannot earn it.

steps.text: On the title screen choose Story, then New Game, then @mechanic{Classic}.
Never change the difficulty during the run, not even for the Chapter 5 race. Changing it once voids the achievement.
Finish @loc{Chapter 20: The Death of Art} in the same run.
